standing: The T2 census on the snapshot ledger (M3-C r8 item 2 as M3-C r9 amends it; units C1a4 and C1a4-blind). Generated by tools/security/snapshot_ledger_census.py from integrity-verified stores; held-out entries are never read here: their rows are composed from the companion blind receipt, and only while it is current. Counts and ids only. Design evidence, not product qualification.
